name: bbox_check
command:
import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
import subprocess, re
r=subprocess.run(["pdftotext","-bbox","output/pdf/bunkbed-transitive-tournaments.pdf","-"],capture_output=True)
print("rc",r.returncode, r.stderr.decode()[:500])
s=r.stdout.decode()
pages=re.findall(r'<page width="([\d.]+)" height="([\d.]+)">(.*?)</page>', s, re.S)
print("pages",len(pages))
for i,(w,h,body) in enumerate(pages,1):
    words=re.findall(r'<word xMin="([\d.]+)" yMin="([\d.]+)" xMax="([\d.]+)" yMax="([\d.]+)">(.*?)</word>', body, re.S)
    if not words:
        print("page",i,"no words"); continue
    xmax=max(float(x[2]) for x in words)
    xmin=min(float(x[0]) for x in words)
    ymax=max(float(x[3]) for x in words)
    print("page",i,"nwords",len(words),"xmin",round(xmin,1),"xmax",round(xmax,1),"ymax",round(ymax,1))
    over=[x for x in words if float(x[2])>558.5]
    print("  over right margin (>558.5):",len(over))
    for o in over[:5]:
        print("   ",o[4][:80],o[2])
